messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "30", "observation": "A low, sustained musical drone is punctuated by metallic scraping, a sharp impact, and a brief, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "90", "observation": "A siren wails, then fades into silence, with no other sounds present."}, {"id": "165", "observation": "A person walks on a hard surface, rustles paper, and a door opens and closes."}, {"id": "180", "observation": "A cat meows, a dog barks, and a door slams shut, followed by rustling and a squeaking sound."}, {"id": "210", "observation": "A cat meows, a dog barks, and a dog growls, followed by a sustained, low-pitched musical tone."}, {"id": "270", "observation": "A sharp metallic impact is followed by scraping, a low hum, and a sustained, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "285", "observation": "A train moves along tracks, producing rhythmic clattering and a deep, resonant horn blast."}, {"id": "330", "observation": "A loud, sustained, high-pitched electronic tone with a metallic, abrasive quality dominates the recording, accompanied by a brief, sharp impact sound."}]
